metadata.question: Did Vietnam have more active fire detections than Myanmar on February 3, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products. FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) provides MODIS Collection 6 and VIIRS active fire data. In GEE, I'll use: - MODIS: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (daily) or "MODIS/006/MCD14DL" (daily swath) - VIIRS: "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML" (daily) I'll use MODIS MCD14DL or VIIRS VNP14IMGML for a specific day. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed - we're counting fire detections directly. Fire products already have confidence levels we can filter by. 3. Logic: - Get fire detections for Vietnam and Myanmar on Feb 3, 2018 - Count the number of fire pixels/points for each country - Compare: if Vietnam > Myanmar, answer A; else B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define date const date = '2018-02-03'; // Define country boundaries const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017'); const vietnam = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Vietnam')); const myanmar = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Burma')); // Get VIIRS active fire data for the specific date const fires = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); console.log('Collection size:', fires.size().getInfo()); if (fires.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No fire data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the image for the date const fireImage = fires.first(); // Select brightness temperature band (indicator of fire) const fireMask = fireImage.select('T13'); // Count fire detections in Vietnam const vietnamStats = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vietnam.geometry(), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const vietnamCount = vietnamStats.get('T13').getInfo(); // Count fire detections in Myanmar const myanmarStats = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: myanmar.geometry(), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const myanmarCount = myanmarStats.get('T13').getInfo(); console.log('Vietnam fire detections:', vietnamCount); console.log('Myanmar fire detections:', myanmarCount); // Validate results if (vietnamCount === null || myanmarCount === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values returned'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (vietnamCount === 0 && myanmarCount === 0) { console.log('No valid fire pixels detected in either country'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare fire detections if (vietnamCount > myanmarCount) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
